scope: Five first-render tasks, each two generated proposals: four new synthetic reading tasks plus one real source-data teaching task. Not a no-skill benchmark, not a general model/CNS/new-user effectiveness claim. Frozen inputs and first-render engine are not modified by reviewer.

preferences.evidence: Six graphite observations, means and SD remain readable; candidate02 uses a slightly wider data rectangle with similar physical bar thickness and clear treatment gap. It gives less left-side dead space without touching marks. Difference is modest.
preferences.limits: Relative source-normalized percentage is not absolute methylation; no new normalization or paired test was independently inferred. No independent SD recomputation performed.

preferences.evidence: Both narrow box widths keep summaries separate from right lanes, and 35-degree long labels fit visibly. Width-only differences do not repair the same point packing failure.
preferences.limits: Neither candidate is a deliverable winner before raw-point spacing/layer repair; angled-label fit was checked visually, as automated QA marks it unchecked.

preferences.evidence: Larger data rectangle and lightly tinted body distinguish the KDE silhouette somewhat better from dark raw rings. Both retain serious packing and contour/summary competition, so this is not acceptance.
preferences.limits: Unequal counts and independently normalized KDE widths are adopted. The preferred shape does not justify changing support, bandwidth or counts.

preferences.evidence: Filled blue/amber/teal circles distinguish the actual mixed three-class cloud more decisively than tiny hollow outlines at 96 dpi. Three-line legend is compact relative to data.
preferences.limits: Boundary symbol cutoff FR-04 needs correction; naturally close fixed quantitative coordinates are not spread or silently jittered. No color-vision/grayscale proof.

preferences.evidence: 7 x 7 mm cells give more padding for 52 decimal labels than candidate01 5.734 mm cells. Fine white seams clarify adjacent cells; sequential magnitude color and 0/6/12 bar are consistent with adopted scale.
preferences.limits: Fixed 0–12 values/order and 90-degree identifiers are retained. This is a readable known-source synthetic matrix, not proof of statistical or model quality.

findings.location: six-long-label-boxes, both candidates: adjacent raw lanes
findings.evidence: Raw dots visibly merge/overlap in multiple lanes, especially denser later groups. Supplied physical packing audit has 45 overlapping-circle pairs, 46 spacing violations and 33 fallback rows for each candidate; numeric retention alone is not visible separation.
findings.requirement: Adopted 9 pt2 points and all observations must remain readable without silently dropping units or claiming valid packing.
findings.action: Increase physically allowed categorical spread within group boundaries; consider a larger side-lane offset coordinated with narrow summaries. After any center-lane proposal, independently recheck median/whisker/point occlusion. Preserve 100 x 80 mm, 8 pt font, point area and 0–30 scale. If a readable arrangement cannot fit those constraints, record the blocker and seek an explicitly changed layout rather than reducing points/data.

findings.evidence: Exposed and Reference have crowded overlapping rings at full view and 96 dpi. Supplied audit has 36 overlapping-circle pairs, 37 spacing violations and 37 fallback rows per candidate. A .1183 pt minimum center distance is much less than the 3.45 pt outer ring diameter.
findings.requirement: Actual mark spacing must support an honest raw-observation layer at fixed 9 pt2, not just source-to-artist retention.
findings.action: Increase categorical packing allowance with verified group-boundary clearance, retaining data/quantitative axes/font/point area. Reinspect actual marks after numerical spacing passes; passing packing alone does not resolve summary intersections. Do not alter KDE bandwidth, numeric values or sample sizes to mimic a desired silhouette.

findings.evidence: Centered hollow points compete with KDE contours and colored IQR rectangles; numerous rings cross contour lines and some ring portions are hidden or interrupted by the summary layer. The white-body candidate does not cleanly separate these layers; merely tinting/widening candidate02 is insufficient.
findings.requirement: Estimated density, raw observations and quartile summary must be distinguishable; hollow marks do not automatically ensure that.
findings.action: Arrange a physically viable category-associated side lane plus narrower KDE contour, or otherwise reserve an actual separate summary position. Verify contour-to-mark and median/IQR visibility on the final image; no data/test/scale changes.

findings.location: three-class-scatter, both candidates: x-boundary point marks
findings.evidence: Green edge circles are visibly cut at right/left plot bounds. Source Class C x11.953665 is only .2723 mm from right boundary in the 70.5282 mm plot versus .6110 mm filled circle radius; actual SVG clips point groups to the data rectangle. Hollow edges extend to .6904 mm.
findings.requirement: Retain full fixed-size symbols without moving measured coordinates or changing locked 0–12 x limits.
findings.action: Allow the few boundary symbol strokes/fills to extend into existing canvas margin, for example a custom renderer with marker clip_on=False while axes limits and centers stay fixed; check complete symbol/canvas clearance in actual PNG/PDF/SVG. Do not expand locked x limits or jitter quantitative x.

findings.location: wide-annotated-matrix, both candidates: overall canvas proportion
findings.evidence: Correct shallow matrix geometry leaves substantial unused vertical canvas in the fixed 128 x 78 mm page. Values/cells are readable; stretching the four rows to fill height would alter cell proportion without new reading benefit.
findings.requirement: Fixed supplied canvas is preserved, while useful geometry should follow the 4 x 13 matrix and label sizes.
findings.action: Retain honest compact matrix; if a future user accepts a shorter canvas, separately propose that physical layout. Do not claim this first-render choice establishes publication-level proportion.

residual_notes: The two packing failures correctly remain needs_revision. More variants or software pass count do not make those first renders successful.
Integer tick formatting can reduce repeated .0 in scatter/distribution axes without changing scales; it is optional polish, not a required scientific fix.
No statistic, significance, pairing, dropped values, new numeric ranges or KDE scientific parameters are authorized as aesthetic repairs.
Independent source-page reproduction and new-agent generalization were not tested in this review.
